reason: The cited lines show a browser locator click and, conditionally, inclusion of a snapshot in the response. They do not show arbitrary code execution on the host, nor access to non-public host/SaaS data. A click could potentially cause data to be sent somewhere depending on the page and element, but these lines alone do not establish a SINK. Similarly, includeSnapshot may return page content, but the cited lines do not establish that the returned content is attacker-controllable.
